text:
Eh, it's fine for a franchised poke place. Ingredients were fresh and the store was clean. Only one employee but they were wearing a mask (Thank you!) 

Like most of these chain poke shops, they drown the bowls in sauce. I got the spicy tuna and it was more like a spicy teriyaki sauce and super salty. 

It's fine if you want something quick but we wouldn't make a trip to go there.

It's really good. The food was delivered quick and the service was kind and very professional. The all you can eat crab was a real treat, we'll definitely be stopping by again soon for that!  I also recommend their grouper, it's the best in the area. Drink selection wasn't bad either.  I'm eager to try the other locations as well. Anyway, I highly recommend Sea Hags to anyone and everyone in the area.

Ordered takeout from here for the first time and was extremely impressed from ordering process to consumption of food.  They even provided an extra level of customer service and called 15 minutes before food would be ready to give me a heads up for pick up.  The food was absolutely amazing, perfectly spiced and seasoned and cooked to perfection.  After we were done eating the first thing we said was we couldn't wait to go back.  Great work Team Lilly's!
Fuzzy shave phenomenal service and I get the spicy beef quesadillas all the time. The vibe there is inviting and you will want more tacos when you are done it can be quite addicting.

Just wanted to say keep up the good work. We've been coming in on Sundays and sometimes through the week and all experiences have been good the last one being the best one. I shared a picture to show how long it took to get our food from when we ordered. I was impressed with the time.

This evening I was venturing solo around downtown Boise... Decided to grab some all-day-brunch food at Tupelo Honey at 5pm and I don't regret it at all!  

I ordered the "Shoo Mercy" Omelet with a side of Potato Cracklins and it was excellent.  I asked for some hot sauce and was expecting to get a bottle of Tabasco or Texas Pete, but was pleasantly surprised to get a ramekin of this sweet tangy hot sauce that was obviously made there in the kitchen.  

The service was good, although business was slow due to social distance regulations.  For my first visit to a Tupelo Honey I had a positive experience. Would definitely recommend the Omelets!

Okay. I love hole in the wall joints and we came here because there was a Hattie B's across the street that was slammed and had a line out the door around the building so we went here instead.

We ordered, so far so good...then came the wait. We stood outside for literally an hour after we ordered our food. Granted, it was busy in there and it's a little shop but we couldn't figure out what about our orders was taking so long. Putting two sides from a hot bar and some pieces of chicken doesn't seem like a momentous task. We were so hungry waiting that we went to the Little Caesar's next door for cheesy bread to tide us over. Not great.

Anyway, the mac and cheese was disappointing and the baked beans were pretty good -- sweet like I grew up eating so I enjoyed them. The "medium" hot chicken -- holy hell it was hot. Be warned! If you really like it hot, medium or hot might be for you, but two of my friends who like spicy food were only able to eat half of one tender. I powered through all of mine but I took breaks and used plenty of ranch. Be ready to sweat and cause a commotion. I only suffered a bit of acid reflux that night, no further consequences from eating those demon tendies, thankfully.

TL;DR  the chicken was good, the sides weren't, maybe worth going to another place that can serve your food to you within an hour.
Fast and delicious slices. One of my favorite pizza places in Tampa. This place does not offer beer or wine. Family friendly and cost effective.
We absolutely love eating here. Always delicious food. Even during quarantine... best take out food. My favorite chips and garlic shrimp by far.

Very bad idea to remove servers. Made it EXTREMELY difficult to order. We were double charged for drinks and the manager never came to fix one of our multiple bills we had due to having to pay for each item you order.  We couldn't get napkins or refills  excuse the bar line was so long. My husband waited in line at the bar so long to order a side of fries when he got back to the table his actual meal was already cold. Please please bring back servers. Please

Maybe they were having a bad day.  The worst breakfast burrito I've ever eaten, perhaps the worst on planet earth.  How can a chorizo burrito be so tasteless.  It was sad, maybe because I had such high hopes.  Everything related to chorizo has a little kick, a little spice.  Not this burrito.  

The breakfast burrito came highly recomended by a phlebotomist.  She looked well fed so I figured this might work out.  It didn't.

My dog liked it though.  So I won't return here.  My dog, that's up to him.
Amazing. Absolutely delicious food. A little bit of a wait, but byob so have a beer while you wait.
Best Chinese food in Sparks. We order takeout from here all the time. The price is perfect especially for the quality you get. Highly recommend!

If I could rate this establishment a 0 I would. I have never felt more disrespected. We come in here and no one is there to tell us we have to seat ourselves or explain that to us for like ten minutes. Then we get seated, and I feel bad for the one waitress running the show, I give her credit for making it work. Takes some time for us to order due to that, not a big deal. The issue arose when we received our receipt. I ordered the 8$ bundle where it had six wings, fries and a drink. It was not disclosed to me that the meal deal was only available on the weekdays. When i ordered it, i asked if i could substitute the fries for cheese curds. The waitress said no problem, it'll be around a $2 up charge. I said no problem. I get the receipt and i am charged $6 for cheese curds and all and i ask them about it. The manager had a bad attitude towards us along another worker. After some back and forth conversation the manager says she can take $2 off. Cool. Then my boyfriend asked if he could use his veterans discount. She says yes if it is valid. He then shows her his VA Card. She says that is not valid and tried to argue with him on this. Absolutely ridiculous. In the end we got the veterans discount. All is well now, I guess. I still got charged over $8. Be weary coming into this location, they do not clarify details for you and get frustrated when you ask why.

Update: My boyfriend explained the different VA cards to the manager, and she seemed apologetic and more understanding af

They have the worst turkey burgers in the business,, it's a processed patty that is so hard and the taste is foul ,, the steak and fried chicken players are ok but do not order a turkey burger , just skip that part of the menu

Came here for my birthday and Jann Arden was playing.  I had read a previous review of this venue so I was prepared to not get into any of the restaurants and have to grab a hot dog.  That was a bummer but not a big deal.  

We played a few slot machines and had the best service from 2 lovely servers.  And our drinks we great.  We didn't have anything fancy just vodka and soda, but they were great!

We didn't make it rich (money wise) but had a really good time in the casino and for Jann's show.  The audio did seem off a few times, but it didn't spoil the show.  I was happy with the seating, it was arranged really well and the chairs were comfy.  I'd come back here again for a show.  

Only down fall is leaving the venue.  It was a standstill.  No one knew where to go or how to get out.

The food was okay. We got the lamb and beef. Not very flavorful- definitely need the sides it comes with. I would suggest getting the crispy lamb because it gave it more texture and better flavor. The restaurant is in the back of the bar. There are two entrances (front and side). Large bar area in the front. The bartender was working as the waitress too so she was doing a lot of back and forth to serve both areas. Food took about 30+ minutes to come out. There was one other table before us. 

Very casual location. 

Street parking. Can be difficult to find parking since the restaurant/bar is located in a residential area.

The owners of this McDonald's location have a nicely updated building -- that's where the "1" rating comes from. 
The service is horribly slow, employees walking around  & yelling at each other and at customers like they cant deal with work -- flat out rude, disrespectful, and obviously they don't care. 
The restaurant food was below typical McDonald's quality, and nothing was restocked in the lobby for customers to help themselves with beverages -- empty iced tea dispensers, empty cup lids, etc. 
Please give your restaurant and customers better than this.

Came in for lunch and to start with the decor was dated, and the owner had a solo picture of himself smiling on the wall, which are red flags. But I was with other people, so I went with it. The owner whistled the same line of Africa by Toto over and over while he bartended/bussed/etc. for our ENTIRE MEAL (over an hour), which absolutely drove me and my companions up a wall. It sounds like a joke, I know. The server dropped our menus on the table without looking at any of us or saying a word and didn't come back for 15 minutes to speak to us for the first time. Finally, the food was pretty clearly just a way to capitalize on the Italian Market location. I recognized my gnocchi as the same frozen ones I could buy at the supermarket for $4, just priced $15 instead. There are so many beautiful shops and eateries with fresh delicacies on this street. Go to any of them instead of this place.

We visit New Orleans often, and always need at least one meal here. So many delicious items on the menu! The service is friendly and attentive, with a welcoming, enjoy-yourself vibe. Fresh-shucked oysters are especially good here. In fact, hard to go wrong with any of the menu, and beers are (as one might expect) great!

Thai food is one of my favorite cuisines, however I won't be ordering from Pattaya again! I ordered the pad Thai and it tasted like no other pad Thai I've ever had (not in a good way...). It was extremely greasy and oily. I ended up throwing it out. Do not recommend!

We had a party of 11, we were told that they only had one table that seated a party of 11 and that the wait would be around 2 hours. We were offered a shorter wait time if we took 3 separate booth. If we decided to have dinner together,  what is the purpose of eating separately ?! I'm sure we're not the only party that has 11 or more people. It would be nice if reservations accommodations were considered. Perhaps, if the party doesn't show within  5 mins of reservation time give the seats up. Simple.....

As an appetizer we ordered queso and cheese. My daughter found hair in the chips. Waiter comes back and says she'll have it taken off our check. Of course when we received our check, it wasnt taken off and we had to remind her. 

I've had the fried shrimp numerous times prior to this visit.  This time it was layers of batter, which was disgusting.  Couldn't tell the difference from a chicken tender vs shrimp. I don't know if the cooks changed or what happened,  but VERY disappointed. Cheddars used to be my FAVORITE place to eat at but won't be going back no time soon.
I don't say this often, but they have the best wings around. Pizza is very good also. Great spot!
The food was amazing if I lived near here I would be a regular but we live in Denver Colorado, but will definitely come if in the area.

Food is not good at all!   Refried beans and queso were runny!  Waiters are meh!  Waiters constantly disputing what the customer wants instead of listening to the request. Too much orange juice in house  margarita.. food lacked any depth and flavor.  Took forever for the food to come out. Probably NEVER going back.

So today I decided to drive 19 miles to Mike's Brick Oven Pizza to try their pizza. It certainly was the right decision. I could tell even before I walked in that this was a good choice! How? It was the steady stream of customers walking out with 2 or more pizza boxes and large bags of food. I was pleasantly greeted by Shannon and I informed her this was our first time there. Even though it was the busy lunchtime period, Shannon took the time to let me know of the daily specials and the loyalty program. I ordered two of their pizzas and was immediately surprised. The large size was truly a 16 inch large and was absolutely delicious. The sauce was especially tasty and flavorful as well as the rest of the ingredients. The dough was perfect and had just the right amount of chew. I love to try pizzas from all over and this was one of the best. It certainly isn't in my back yard and I will be going back for more of their menu. Do you know how many pizza places I pass in 19 miles? That alone should tell you about the quality of their product. Can hardly wait to try their Sicilian pie!
Thank you to the cook, Shannon, and the rest of the crew! Like Arnold says...I'LL BE BACK!

Consistently delicious.  We come with a two and four year old so we aim for off peak hours.  Their kids burgers are the perfect size.  If your kid likes Mac and cheese and is a bit picky, ask for the Mac on the side of the hotdog, not on top.  

Service is good, and the food is consistent.  I don't usually stray from a classic cheeseburger with toppings and fries or onion rings.  They have some pretty creative options, though.  

Pro tips...

If you order a kids meal, it comes with a drink.  If you don't want your kid to have soda, then save it for yourself and get your kid a water!

The lady at the to go order line was very rude, bot friendly at all, I believe her name was Jemaira.... everyone at Chipotle was much friendly except for the manager (great example) also, she call the attention of three girls at the food line that were simply waiting for the customer ( is not a good example to call someone attention in public) that way they were waiting for the line as it was empty, and she just told them in a loud manner, why are you all just standing there... not a very good way to do it.

Always an amazing time here. Kyla is by far such a personable and friendly bartender. We always make sure to come when she is here. Tried breakfast recently and loved it. Pancakes and eggs were cooked perfectly. Overall a gem in Soulard.
All noodles, virtually no sauce. We've went back 3 or 4 times thinking it would be better. Shame on us. It's getting to the point where we are wondering how this place is still in business.

came to Santa Barbara for the night.... just cause. we were staying at the hyatt place which just happens to be right next door to this gem. we were wondering where to eat when we got here.......... problem solved !!!  Ezmerelda was our server and made us feel at home. the food was top notch and real home made. we will for sure be back when ever we are here.

So good!! Just moved out from California and was worried that I wouldn't find good poke that tasted fresh out in the Midwest! But I was so wrong! This place was amazing! I ordered online to pick up, but as I was waiting to pick up the team member was very patiently and kindly explaining each item to the woman in front of me who had clearly never had poke before. Each team member I saw was so incredibly nice and polite! You could tell they were smiling even through their mask! The only thing I'll miss from my old poke spots in Cali are the crispy fried garlic for the top, but everything else was top notch!

We visited on Sat. Aug 1 and was so disappointed. We arrived around 5:30 and put in our name, gave our cell phone and was told that the wait would be :45 to an hour. We then left to do a little quick shopping. Apparently they texted us :15 mins later, but we didn't hear the alert. When we arrived back at the restaurant :40 mins later advised them we missed the text. They said no problem and offered to seat us as soon as they could. They had a large tent set up with tons of Adirondack chairs (not socially distanced for those waiting with a guy singing and playing music who was pretty good actually.) The whole area had at least 30 people all crammed inside the tent with NO masks. We opted to wait outside that area for safety purposes. Was then escorted to the outside bar where they had decided to seat us. Eh, NO! We then left. We're from out of town and always eat there and is a favorite-not this time though. Will give a try next time we're in town. Sorry.

Food is surprisingly good- didn't expect much from bland exterior but were pleasantly surprised at the quality of meat, vegetables, and attention to food and flavor. They don't skimp on their ingredients either- a big plus for future success. Tried their rolls, fried rice, pho, bun bo hue- all were amazing and flavorful. One of the best fried rice had by the kids, they ranked it #1 of all time. Thank you for a wonderful meal!
Me and my wife love this place!! They have great food , fast service and reasonable prices.

We found this gem on Yelp! The food is amazing and the hospitality was great. If you want some bomb breakfast burritos you found your spot  
We loved it so much we will be back again tomorrow morning.

Summary:  A good introduction to Filipino food with room to grow.

 
I went to Mata's on opening day around lunch time. There was a line and you could feel the crowd, myself included, was eager and excited to try the food.  I ordered the Combo #1 which came with sisig and lechon along with one order of beef lumpia and two boba teas.  The Sisig was delicious, the pork tender and perfectly complimenting the rest of the dish along with a perfect level of tanginess.   The beef lumpia was lukewarm but otherwise okay; it tasted as it should- no complaints here.  There is a lot of beef in it, so don't expect a bunch of other things like veggies (after all, everyone does it a little different).   The lechon was disappointing.  The skin was well seasoned and crispy (yum) but the meat under it was dry.  Also, like the lumpia, the lechon was  lukewarm.  I think the way the food is stored prior to ordering is why they are served lukewarm.  I felt the portions were good for $10.99.  The boba tea was terrible.  The tapioca pearls were rather bland and they did not put enough taro flavoring into my tea.  My coworker's boba tea had large chunks of ice in it (pictures attached) as it was not blended enough.   I gave my experience a 3/5 but I want to stress there is so much potential here and room to grow and I will definitely come back to try their food and will update my review accordingly.  In fact I am looking forward to it.

You have to be in your "twenties or something.... and 'cool'" with the bartender slamming wine if your here during the evenings. We've come here often on date night and with the family and it's usually a good time and good food. Tonight was nuts. So many things going on, but if the bartender hadn't been slamming wine and showing everyone her phone it might have been a lovely night as usual. Holy smokes though. I've never seen wine slammed that fast....and by a bartender (not to mention the only one working tonight). WOW

Consistently screws up my door dash orders- forgets sauce for nuggets and swaps apple pies for strawberry ones. There's no accountability or way to correct it. I have had zero problems with other restaurants when using door dash. I won't be ordering from this location again.

Before I give my rating for today I want to start by saying I love this location. I have been going to this specific location for years and never had a complaint until today. It seems as if management has changed as the service at atmosphere was horrible. I only gave 3 stars because the food was still good and came out hot but other than that I would have given just 1! First let's start it by the staff seemed over worked, tired, and lazy! I ordered 2 salted caramel lattes and they came out with no whip cream or the normal topping. When I asked where it was they said they ran out of whipped cream!!! I was appalled! Whip cream is $3 how the hell did they run out of it! Ok. Then the staff were seated at a table across form us and was using so much profanity with no cares I had a young child with me. The restaurant was dirty. The floors weren't clean at all. Looked like they hadn't mopped since yesterday. I had to have my table cleaned. 
I knew it was strange their was no wait! Seems like this was my last visit here!
Fast and fresh is the way I would describe this place.  A much needed Tai restaurant in this area and I love eating here weekly.

I'm so glad that we stopped into this place. The food was great and under the recommendations of the bartender we tried the char broiled oysters it was amazing. We had the one at ACME and was wondering why people said it was a must have. We went three days straight enjoyed the food the music and the staff was friendly. We will be back again.

I've eaten at O'Briens on 3 separate occasions. The food was fantastic each time! 
So naturally I was a little concerned when I read some less than stellar reviews. 

O'Briens just started a Sunday Brunch buffet. When I heard there was Prime Rib along with other goodies I couldn't wait to try it. 
Let's see how it goes.

I was accompanied by my Fab O'Babe, her Supreme Hottiness, plus another fun couple. When the four of us get together it's usually in New Orleans, where great food and partying go well together. I told them to trust me, that they'd like the food at O'Briens and the trip was a whole lot easier!

We were seated immediately, but jumped right back up, plates in hand and hit the O'Buffet Bar! 
We instantly spotted perfectly cooked Med Rare slices of succulent looking Prime Rib. Sparks were almost flying as we tonged tons of tender beef onto our tableware!

Another favorite was calling our names..Corned Beef Hash. Plenty of it, ready to leap onto our plates. So far so goooooood!

Then there were whole hog sausages, scrambled eggs, apple wood smoked bacon!, biscuits & gravy, chicken & biscuits, shrimp cocktails, hash browns, potato pancakes, fresh fruit!!!!

And to round this meal out to a loving end, several decadent looking desserts...

ALL of THIS for just $12.99!!!!!!! WHAT?????????
(We were being good, but you can have all this plus bottomless Mimosas, Bloody Marys or Screwdrivers for $24.99)

O'Briens put the O'Boy and O'YESSSS into our Sunday fun day! 
We had
Great chicken quesadilla, live music, cold beer and friendly bartenders. Venue is clean and modern. A great local business to support on Broadway.

I stopped here for breakfast with a friend after a yoga class in Yardley. We were seated outside & I have to say it was a really cute spot. Our waitress was super friendly and we got started with an order for coffee. This is definitely a good spot to get some strong and delicious cafe coffee. I ordered the grande cafe combo which came with pancakes, toast, eggs, choice of meat, home fries. Everything was delicious and after months of not having breakfast outside my home this REALLY hit the spot. I am looking forward to this being my go to breakfast spot now.

Out of the last 4 times I ordered take out, 3 times my order was very wrong. Other restaurants have gotten it together doing increased take out during Covid but this place doesn't seem to have it together at all.
Dinner was delicious! Shawn and Corinne are fantastic bartenders and helped us with choosing the perfect food to pair with the delicious beers

My family and I stopped in from out of town to grab some cheesesteaks as a recommendation from our hotel. Couldn't have been more satisfied with everything we ordered. Everything was delicious and the employees were very friendly. Great place!! Can't wait to go back! We'll be coming back every time we are in town.

This is a great coffee spot to go to! Ive been looking for a place in SB with a welcoming environment and some good coffee, and I've found my go-to. I was greeted with a smile, given a delicious latte, and sat comfortably on a table with my laptop and headphones on. There are PLENTY of outlets, and the wifi is great for doing work. Hands down, an amazing place to chill at and grab a quick coffee as well. (Also getting to see the adorable dogs the customers bring in is great too)

I love everything about Christopher's. And that's saying something since this is location #2 and not all "chains" can pull off expansion while keeping quality high. Why do I love Christopher's? They have the perfect menu for a the basic American spread. Their specialty pizzas are fun and full of flavor. The ambiance is excellent. Indoor and outdoor seating. Bar seating or restaurant seating. Casual, but classy atmosphere. Now there are plenty of places that do one or another of these things better, but Christopher's has done a great job making an overall great with just the right level of quality for a fun evening out.

We were there with a small group last Saturday, September 12th. Excellent service, the food was fantastic I mean really fantastic! We ordered a series of sliders consisting of Buffalo chicken sliders, pulled pork sliders and meatloaf sliders. Wow so good. I myself had a smoked old fashion which was perfect! I cannot wait for the rooftop bar to open. This is a gem in New Port Richey ! If you haven't been there yet, you really need to try this instead of going to Widow Fletchers LOL

This place has never been fast but man it seems like it has fell off. You would think a place with so much competition for sushi around here would step their game up but I guess not. 

I'm literally standing inside the store to write this review because my food is taking so long. It's not even rush hour right now. I called 30 minutes ago and the lady told me that it will be ready in 15 minutes. Show up 15 minutes later, she said 5 more minutes. So I stepped outside. Come back 5 minutes later and I'm still waiting for my food. 

Employees of this store have actually left before I received my food, while I'm assuming the short hair chick sitting over here messing around with her phone is the boss or manager or something. At least others are working. 

Probably wouldn't have ordered. Oh my order just arrived. I hope the food still solid

1hour in line to check in line then the lady gave me attitude. told me I should have gone to the express Vip line which wasn't staffed when I got back in line. Also told me my online reservation wasn't showing up and basically caused unnecessary frustration. I recommend anywhere else. 
While waiting got bit by mosquito in the lobby
Use to be good 5 years ago you can definitely tell they stop caring about the food most of it look like mush and the meat is not up to taste anymore coming from a restaurant owner myself

Found this little gem thanks to yelp and it did not disappoint! My husband had the East Nasty, which was fantastic and I tried the Bonuts, which ended up being one of my favs from our entire Nashville trip! Staff were super nice and great at their jobs. Will absolutely return if we make it back to Nashville!

I was not afraid of this insanely long drive thru line because I'm so used to the Chicago stores that move you through like lightening. But not here...you should be afraid of the line. I hope the food is as good.

Awesome hidden gem and a great place for steamed pork buns. They make them in-house and freeze them so you can take them home and stock up. My Thai tea was awesome and super authentic, but I was a little disappointed in the serving size of the chicken pad Thai...

Lumpia was ok. It wasn't what I'm used to, which is more long and skinny. This had a bit too much meat and not enough veggies and was too thick. I did have the beef tomato bowl (sorry the name escapes me) and it was very good. We had a variety of deserts and they have all been very good.

This is my favorite Mexican hole in the wall. I go here specifically for al pastor tacos. They're simply to die for. If you want a fancy atmosphere, to be waited on hand foot, chips and salsa, and table service, above awesome tacos, go to Don Pablo's or something. This place isn't for you.
The al pastor tacos are the best in Indianapolis. The meat is flavorful, served with onions cilantro, and pineapple (an amazing touch). They also serve Corona Familiar by the quart. Do yourself a favor, go get some tacos and beer with a buddy at this awrsome hidden gem!

Had a really good experience here with my family recently. Our waitress (wish I remembered her name) was so attentive, constantly refilling drinks, and had a great positive spirit. 

The bread and oil are always a hit from here. Family got a variety of entrees, among our favorites: chicken parm, chicken gratinati, and any of the pizzas. 

I ordered the chicken piccata which I get often at Bertucci's. Unfortunately it was really lacking in sauce, but was still good. Love that you get three pieces of chicken with it. 

I would advice Bertucci's to adjust some of their prices, however. It seems like they are trying to be a fine dining Italian place rather than a chain. Other then that, love it here.

This was an amazing brunch experience. The food was impeccable.  The service was warm, efficient and effortless.  The ambience was great for families, friends and little ones too.  Too bad it's closing in December!!  It's some of the best food in St. Louis

3rd trip back to the area.  Maggie Mae's is still excellent for breakfast.  Have not tried the lunch menu...so...no comment. 

We ordered omelets, eggs Benedict, and a couple of specials that included lots of choices.  All were served quickly and were delicious with fresh veggies, eggs, toast, meats and eggs.  

We all drank water or soft drinks so no coffee review.  

Love sitting outside on the intercoastal waterway.  

Fast service.  Reasonably priced. Very clean.  5 minute walk from the Sheraton Sand Key.
I had the red beans and rice. It was ok.  The service was great. The red beans and rice were a nice sized portion.  They weren't overwhelmingly good. I will probably not go back unless i needed to.

Normally my wife and I are stoked to come here for dinner or something small while we have a beer. Yet last night our to go order left us a little disappointed. We ordered a Bbq chicken pizza, and it was good but, the box was so soggy it changed the crust texture of the pizza. Maybe they should invest in some liners or save some money and use less grease. The big disappointment was we ordered wings and when we got home, the steam filled box actually had ribs in it. Granted they were alright, they weren't what we ordered or paid for. My take always, don't order take out... and if you want wings, go somewhere else. We will go back but it'll probably be a while.

Go for brunch! It was amazing! Bottomless mimosas or bloody Mary's, not a ton of options for entrees but what they have they do it perfectly! I had the eggs Apolline, which was so delicious! A friend got the shrimp and grits, also delicious with more spice to it! Our waiter was very sweet, and always made sure we were taken care of! Something to be aware of for groups is that they don't do separate checks. We will be back!

The Chipotle on Grand is without question the worst Chipotle I've ever visited. Staff can't properly roll a burrito, but it might not be completely their fault -- the tortilla was stale and crusty. Also wish I could forget the messy conditions they were working under behind the bar. Place is gross. Just a terrible experience. I can promise I will never return to this location.

Great experience! Friendly staff, quick service and yummy tea! I ordered the chamomile tea and was surprised how big the cup was. Granted I normally make tea at home, I was happily surprised. Perfect seating area outside as well. Thank you!
Fabulous in every way. The horchata is spectacular, so is everything else including the staff.

I love super spicy foods and fried chicken. But yo, Hattie bs has the absolute HOTTEST chicken you will ever eat. My first bite was the pickle slice on top of my chicken. I instantly started sweating. 2 bites into my chicken I had started crying. 4 bites in I felt nauseous and had already soaked multiple napkins in sweat. After the FIRST PIECE of chicken down, I was an absolute mess with major snot running, tears, gallons of sweat and a stomach full of burning coal. I think my body was melting on the inside. To be fair, they warned me against it.
Cool chic space. Lots of local beers on top, but mostly mediocre. Mediterranean food was good, but not phenomenal.

We have tried most of the Thai places in town and this is by far the BEST. Fresh ingredients, perfect flavors and the prices are not outrageous. This is our go-to Thai take out restaurant. The fresh spring rolls are so good and fresh. Panang curry is our favorite dish along with drunken noodles and curry pop chicken.
Great beer selection & very friendly staff!  Definite recommend.  It's a secret gem off the beach.
Must have Frosé! We will be back again!!! Beautiful atmosphere, friendly staff. We would definitely recommend this place over and over again to her friends.

The environment is very kid friendly and sporty. The tavern area is also very nice! Service was not bad, as we were greeted by kind waitresses. It was a seat-yourself which I liked a lot. We chose a booth which was slightly dirty even considering it wasn't super busy. But the waitress who came was very friendly to the kids and I would like to shout her out for that. The waitress did not seem to be wearing a name pin which would have been helpful. The bathrooms smelled good and were feminine/child friendly. They had a poster in our aging people to call a cab home rather than driving home drunk. I really wish the waiters and waitresses had name tags because I would love to shout out our waitress we had today. The food was amazing! I am vegetarian so I eat a lot of salads and the one I had here is one of the best I've ever had! We finally found out the waitresses name, so thank you so much Jen! She was very nice and super friendly with the kids. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because of minor things like cleanliness.

We really liked this place. 2 of the 3 sauces are really good, the smoke on the meat was perfect and the sides that we tried were all delicious (green beans, rancho beans and Mac and cheese). My husband got an old fashion - it was delicious and strong. I tried the habanero mango cider and it was also really good. My only complaint was the amount of meat on the plate. The chicken sandwich was much more bread then meat. I ordered brisket and was given two pieces. They were decent sized, but considering the draw is bbq, I wish we had received more of it. Overall we liked this place and we will be back.
Thoroughly enjoyed the salad and love the cavatelli with pesto sauce.  My son loves the cannelloni and my husband thoroughly enjoyed his tortellini.

Since homeboy that answered the phone will remember me because we got into a screaming argument and he kept saying this isn't my problem and I won't be refunding you. EVEN THOUGH I DIDNT WANT A REFUND I JUST WANTED HIM TO BE AWARE OF HOW POORLY THEY MADE MY FOOD. I'd like everyone to see how "delightful" this pizza I got from this sauce location was. The delicious black burnt flour on the bottom, the grease all over the box from the pizza being tossed around, and the delightful phone call experience I recorded and had with the "manager" will be why I no longer will be a customer here :) thx. Update I ate it because I paid for it & no one was gonna replace it so that's why 1 slice is missing.

Absolutely love this place! Great coffee, great food, homey feeling! 

Very small & often crowded so it can be hard to find a table especially for a bigger party. 

The coffee is very well done, cold brew is great & the chia has some extra spice! 

The food is so fresh, & I've loved every hash I've gotten here, my bf & I love the vegan chorizo on the hash. My new favorite dish is the shakshuka which may have been a special for the day unfortunately. 

As a regular, I highly recommend.
Amazing beignets! They were quick and efficient, we got our beignets quick and even got a chance to watch them make the beignets.

Man, I really want to say Hot Rods has improved since the announcement of new management.  We went 2 years ago and it was terrible. We went 2 months ago and it wasn't too bad.  I had a smoked chicken wings and nacho combo that wasn't bad.  But then some friends want to try it so we went. I gave them the entire Hotrods story and about why it has such low ratings but said the last time we were there it wasn't bad at all. Well we ate there last week and the service was good, our food did take a while to get to us though. I had a meat lovers Calzone, and at first it was really good, nicely cooked, flaky, buttery dough some strips of sausage and pepperoni and cheese, but as I got towards the middle it was cold and doughy.  Now I told them about this and they went and put it back in the oven.  but Here's the thing... I can go into any Denny's/IHOP/Shari's/Village Inn in the country and receive a consistent meal quickly. They can cook it right, it will be warm, and it will taste decent.  Hotrods can not accomplish this task. They have gotten rid of the  Carolina BBQ, Gyros and other problematic things on their menu, but still can't manage to make sure something is heated all the way through.  They are down to fried finger foods, salads, nachos, sandwiches, and calzones/pizza.  Now my wife said Nachos were "okay". Our friends had a patty melt and a swiss mushroom burger and they were okay.  I don't know what Hotrods can do at this point to save themselves.  Hell, hire the line cooks

I didn't know what to expect and was hesitant to order the Curry Ramen... to my surprise it was amazing.  Since I'm not as familiar with all the complexities of curry, I cannot go too much in detail.  What I can say, is the flavor was balanced.  The curry was not overwhelming and had a slight sweetness.  I ordered it as take out because they were closing, although they have indoor and patio seating opened in this COVID season, which I appreciate. This is important to note because when I got home and opened the bag, all the necessities were included.  Chop sticks, napkins and soy sauce.  What I found very cool was the to-go system they use!  I'd never seen a contraption like this!  It was a large bowl with a plastic lid that held all the things that were go into the broth.  The ramen, boiled egg, pork slices, bamboo shoots, green onion, mushroom, ginger.  I'm not sure that my dish had the seaweed and the fried onions.  Even so, the flavor was a party in my mouth!  I enjoyed every but and could not stop eating it until it was all consumed!  It was a large amount of soup for the price and taste.  I'm a big fan of Raijin Ramen, so it was fun to try something different!  I will definitely be back! I'd like to see what the dine in experience is like.  Also worth mentioning, for us Americans who don't know the ramen ways, they have signage to help you navigate how to order.

We dined there on Sunday, 9/9/18 for lunch. We were happy to see that they were open after a short hiatus. We love the gyro so I had the sandwich and my better half had the platter! Yum! We enjoy eating here especially because it's a family owned place, and they are always very gracious hosts who provide a delicious meal we can count on. Can't wait to get back and get some of my favorites.

Update: they are open 2-7 for takeout Tuesday to Sunday. Help support local businesses! Thanks!

This was my first time trying Costa Vida and I was impressed! When I first saw the food I was unsure. It didn't look very appetizing but I was wrong. I got the Baja Bowl with cilantro-lime rice, black beans, and shredded beef. It was surprisingly good! I will definitely be back to try some other options.
Yum. I'm not a very good writer so I'll just say I love this place.

We popped in after seeing a friend post a picture of one of their hot dogs a few weeks prior.  We were incredibly impressed with their COVID precautions, and even more pleased with the quality of the food.  We tried a little bit of everything on the menu (hot dogs, fries, and kids chicken tenders) and it was all good. The price was right as well! We hope this neighborhood spot is here to stay!

The highlight of the meal was definitely the size, flavor, and quality of the kids chicken tenders. They were clearly homemade and they were delicious!
Butter burger and the pork tenderloin are both awesome and cheese curds or onion rings along with the tasty milkshakes or a malt make a great lunch

Not my abuela's cooking (although still decent) and we found it a bit overpriced for the type of food; but understandable because of the location. I know there are not many options in the area so it's a good option when feeling home sick. The sweet plantains were great and so was the coffee!

Three and a half stars? 

So many people are telling us to try the new Land Ocean -- and I have to say.. good, not great. So many other places to try, not sure we'll head back. 

The decor is upscale mall restaurant. Reminds me of Paul Martin's. The service was good (Andrew?) The crowd was hit or miss. A table a few over from ours were enjoying shots and beer in holiday party mode. 

The food, which is why we go - wasn't spectacular. We had the Sea Bass and a steak. An overdressed salad and a appetizer that I cannot even remember. That's not a good sign. 

The bar is gorgeous and we may come back for a cocktail before a movie. Try it - maybe your experience will be better than ours.

This place sucks!  Don't waste your time or money. 
I ordered from them via GrubHub and the order wasn't delivered in almost one and a half hours.   First, I tried contacting the restaurant, no one had the balls to answer the telephone and it went to the fax machine. I ended up chatting with the piss poor representative from GrubHub who claims she called and they answered advising the order would be there in 10 more minutes. This is after I have already waited for the order an hour and 20 minutes. To make matters worse, GrubHub informs me my refund won't be available for 5 to 10 days.  Shame I can't wait 5 to 10 days to pay for the food.
Order from ANYPLACE other than this place and from ANYONE other than GrubHub!

Been meaning to stop by here and glad I finally did.  Went to the Barnes museum with a friend early and finished right around lunch time.  Browsed the area for places we could walk to from the museum since we had already parked and this popped up.  Restaurant is smaller than I expected but welcoming and the staff is friendly and attentive.  We ordered the spinach, harvest, and nutella pies.  Really enjoyed the squash on the seasonal harvest the the seeds were a nice crunchy touch.  The cheese on the spinach was the best part and the nutella pie speaks for itself, who doesn't love nutella and marshmallow.  Would definitely come back and try some of the other pies, the boar one sounded good and I love a basic margarita.

This was our first time here (came after reading Yelp reviews) and we are so glad we did! The food was excellent,served piping hot, the service was amazing, and the overall restaurant was sparkling clean. Prices were extremely reasonable. Such a great find!!!

Egg Roll Number 1's service is always so fast and they have great quality Pho! The people are very nice and do a great job working quickly. It's a spot that I go to regularly and I highly recommend the good food for a good price. 10/10 I would go again!

How does this place only have 3.5 stars?! That's crazy. Seriously good pizza, and out the door under $20 for a large, I'm in! The sauce is definitely sweet, but not overwhelming! I called ahead (around 5pm) and placed an order to be picked up at 7:15pm. I walked in at 7:13 and my pizza was coming out of the oven! Perfect!
Nachos here are very good, wings are small and over cooked. Drinks are a bit too expensive. I would go here more often if they lowered drink prices. $7.00 for a glass of wine?  No thanks.

First time eating at Bonchon tonight and my experience at the University City location was fantastic! Upon entering we were greeted by a friendly host and seated right away. Our server, although only his 3rd day on the job, was attentive and professional. He was patient when it took us a while to decide what we wanted before ordering, and checked in periodically until we were ready. Drinks came quickly and food came not too long after. My friend waited a little bit longer than my other friend and I for her chicken, but was able to eat her fried rice while waiting for the chicken to arrive. The food was absolutely delicious - I wish I'd taken photos! I got a small order of the sweet crunchy boneless wings and the udon soup. Both were sensational. I took some of the chicken home and had it a couple hours later and it was still just as good. Overall, I had an excellent meal at Bonchon University City and will most definitely be returning soon!

Always a favorite of me and mines! Marinos does fresh food well, nothing ever tastes old or stale. The service is always fairly quick, even on their busiest nights. My favorite sandwich is their Grilled Chicken Pesto, so much flavor! I love that they incorporate locally sourced ingredients when they can!

I order poke doke for lunch A LOT because it feels like a health conscious alternative to my other quick lunch options. The quality is consistent; I know my favorite order will be the same quality any given day. They deliver through a third party app, but it's also super easy to just go in and pick it up yourself.

The absolute worst taco spot I've ever been too...from the customer experience to the food. It started off with us wanting Birria tacos. I heard that this place made them so I couldn't wait to get some. We placed our order. For 2 orders of the Birria tacos and 2 al pastor, grilled pork and pineapple tacos. In the beginning everything was ok. We sat and waited patiently. We saw order after order..person after person leave and after 30 minutes still no tacos. I asked hey what are we waiting on..they said we were up next. Still waited for 15 minutes until finally I asked the cashier "ma'am where is our food". They lost our order even though we were 6ft away. After which I asked for a full refund of our money...the person in charge told us no. Because I used my card...I asked for cash and she said she couldn't do that either because she wasn't the owner. We had two options continue to wait or come back tomorrow for a refund. Angrily we waited for our food and she gave us complimentary queso for the hour of our lives we wasted. We get home and our chips for our guacamole are missing!!! So we have guacamole and queso but no chips!! Then I bite into the al pastor taco and it was the worst taco I've ever had! It tasted like mush. I don't even think it was meat..it was absolutely horrible.
I will never go...or recommend this place unless we are mortal enemies. Worst taco experience ever..

Service is terrible, restaurant was empty and told us it was a 20-25 minute wait. Sat in the parking lot for a hour with no call or text. Find a better place to go to not worth it. Buffalo Wild Wings right next to it save your time and go there instead!

One of the rudest people to answer the phone in a long time. As soon as the lady answered, she was incredibly rude and then when I was done ordering, she hung up on me without even telling me how long till my food was ready. I called back to ask how long and she responded "3 minutes" with an attitude and hung up. 

They are lucky that the food is good because their staff is frankly terrible.

I ordered a V8 vegan and spud fries and waited for 20 MINUTES! Luckily at that point my boyfriend suggested I ask them about my order (yes i realize i should've asked earlier oops). They gave me 4 coupons for free spud fries as consolation. But the coupons are only valid with a burger purchase AND it says dine-in only. Oh and while I was in there someone else brought their burger to the counter because it had a hair on it...yikes!! 

I'm only giving 2 stars because it has good vegan options. I used to love this place despite being a bit pricy. I probably will not be back.

Top shelf in all categories!

Quiet, pleasant, BOOTHS!, great service an GREAT FOOD.
Pricy!!!! but worth it.

First time there was Thanksgiving.  Lobster Bisque, Turkey, and the best Chocolate Pecan pie that I have ever eaten.

Will be back!

I have been here several time but never give them a review. One thing I like the most about this restaurant is their lunch special and honey butter bun. The honey butter bun is delicious and is complimentary item before the meal with cinnamon butter. The lunch special has attractive pricing and affordable. 

We were here for their MLK special. I got the sirloin steak with rice and chili. The steak was grilled to temperature requested. It is juicy. The chili is really nice with ground meat. We have the half rack pork rib as appetizer. It is folk tender and fall off the bone. My wife have the country fried steak. The coating is seasoning with spice and crispy. Good size piece of meat. 

Our service is good. Food come on time. Not much of wait. During pandemic, they seat groups in every 15 minutes.

I've only got food from here once, but the Chicken Tikka Masala pizza is probably now my favorite pizza. A few things that are different about this place. One is the Indian inspired pizzas on the menu. Another is that the are conscious of dietary restrictions. They have option for vegetarians, vegans, there are gluten free options, and even egg free options. Bottom line, everyone needs to get to this place ASAP!

I wound not come here again. The portions of the sushi were really small compared to other sushi restaurants I been to. I feel like I overpaid for my dishes. They also lacked flavor. The shrimp tempura was missing that special tempura sauce that makes it pop.

Ok so I have always seen this place when I go to Franklin and I think they just opened one up near me in Brentwood but I honestly thought it was just *another* southern barbecue place. The truth is that 55 stands out. It's in a great location and the food is EXCELLENT. More than that, the service was excellent. I wish I had the name of our server but he was so helpful and extremely personable. Sometimes I feel like waiters and waitresses are trying to "sell" certain items on the menu, he was honest and did not steer us wrong. I got the Nashville Hot chicken plate that was outstanding and I was between that and the fried green tomato pimento sandwich and I have been dying to go back just to try it. Everyone loved their meals. We were sitting outside and it started to rain and they quickly came out and shuffled us to a better spot. Really on top of it. The parking is a tad tricky since it's on Main Street but they were accurate in the wait time they gave us - it seems to be a pretty popular place to eat so I think next time I will plan on going closer to the opening time. However, since it is on Main Street we were able to walk around and look in the shops while we waited and the time passed quickly. DEFINITELY recommend and plan on returning!
This is the buffet inside the Hardrock in Tampa. Brunch was very good. For buffet some of the best. If your Elite its an amazing deal.
I'm stymied by how delicious this vegan buffalo chicken pizza is. Every topping is absolutely delicious. The service and atmosphere are also equally as incredible!

It was my daughter's 19th birthday today and she attends  the  University of Arizona in Tucson and she asked for  her birthday dinner to be at an all you can eat Korean BBQ so she picked 7 ounce Steak House on Speedway Blvd The place is great a very cool vibe when you walk in  With a young energetic friendly helpful staff who give you great service We had the all you can eat buffet for 24.95 and the food kept coming it was delicious it was tasty it was fast everything was great Our personal waiter was Griffin and he was awesome and all the staff was right there attentive and helpful I called them earlier asking what they could do for my daughter's birthday and he made some great suggestions so I ordered all three deserts and they came out at the end of the dinner with this really cool drum show and sang  happy birthday and gave her ice cream with a big sparkler in it The owner should be proud of the people he has working for him and the quality of his food I promise you will not leave hungry

Almost skipped this place based on the reviews but really glad we didn't. Food was delicious and the employees were super friendly. We had the chicken and tri tip combo, chicken sandwich, and al pastor tacos. All were great, fresh, and tasty. Looking forward to coming back!

Unfortunately, this evening my party of four had a VERY unpleasant experience at this establishment. Before our visit, we checked their website and menu for specials. We found the drink and food specials located on their website's menu below. However, when we received the bill, everything was priced at normal menu value (approx. $12 worth of savings). When approaching our waiter and then manager, we were told their menu had changed due to COVID-19. While I understand that menu's have changed, there was no mention on their website of any menu changes. According to the manager and waitress, WE should have ALSO checked their FACEBOOK page for an updated menu. While trying to come to a full understanding of why they could or would not honor the deal, both the waitress and manager became INCREASINGLY AGGRESSIVE until it reached a borderline hostile level. Then, when continuing to ask the manager so that I could fully understand the situation, she WALKED AWAY while I was STILL ATTEMPTING to CONVERSE WITH HER. Thoroughly unimpressed with how my party was treated tonight; I will not be back to this establishment. (Rating due to treatment of customers, NOT being upset about the $12 that wasn't saved.)

Great food, feels and tastes what I imagine is authentic. The owner was very instructive and friendly. Told great jokes and talked a lot about making the food. Had spicy soup and it was fabulous. Great outdoor seating. Yes

Wow I tried this place based on the 4 1/2 stars review and I was wrong. I spent $30 on two orders and it was beyond bland...my curry dish tasted like water and curry powder (add some boiled vegetables) and second dish was clear stir fried noodles with zero taste. I requested for medium spice too! Heavy sigh don't bother with this place unless you have IBS and need something ultra bland and tasteless.

If I could give this place 0 stars, I would. 
Our first clue should have been a nearly empty restaurant at 6:00 p.m. on a Friday night in midtown. The second should have been the servers in sweats.
The service was absolutely terrible, the tacos are a joke, unless you want a cabbage taco, and they randomly add a gratuity to your check without telling you so you double tip. We asked to speak to a manager due to the bill issue, and we were informed that the manager thought it was okay to leave the restaurant without management on a Friday night. When I questioned the server (who never gave us her name over the course of our 2.5 hour visit thanks to her incredibly slow service), she got defensive over it. 

Do yourself a favor and go literally anywhere else for dinner in Nashville. If you do decide to give this place a try, make sure you get your receipt and pay attention to it, and definitely keep an eye on your bank account.

I just had lunch at Fattoush and will definitely be going back.  The food was fresh, delicious, and presented well. The restaurant was clean and roomy.  I had the chicken gyro with the fattoush side salad.  My boss had the beef shawarma also with the Fattoush side salad.  The sandwiches were full and delicious and the salad was fantastic.  I think this will be a new regular spot for my team.

Drinks here were good, server was pleasant, lights outside were nice, and this is in a great shopping district; we didn't eat anything here as we only stopped for drinks and to talk and relax a bit, but other patrons were enjoying themselves, so this seems like a good place and our drink experience was a good one.

I visited this place for the first time tonight, and it was a great experience. The food was great, especially the Wagyu Beef Combo, and the service was excellent. Our server, David, was especially attentive and went above and beyond to make this a great dining experience for us. The wait was a bit long, but I would still recommend this restaurant for anyone craving high quality hot pot.

That whole strip of restaurants is so solid - Za, Biscuit Love, and the latest I've tried: The Grilled Cheeserie! They're forming a whole little colony of yummy trendy spots right off of 21st - I love it! 

This place is really great. It gives off the vibes that it's a food truck turned store front, but they've pulled it off well. Simple modern decor, chill vibes, and of course, amazing grilled cheese. 

The pimento Mac and cheese grilled cheese was the first thing I read on the menu and I stopped right there and ordered - did not disappoint! I'm sure all of the other sandwiches are great too but this seemed like such an irresistible novelty.
Food is always amazing, and the staff is always so helpful polite and fun. They always go the extra mile and have been a lifesaver during quarantine.

We have now ordered from here twice. 

1. Our first time I talked to Rodney (who is awesome) and I got the Pork Lover's Barrel. It was PHENOMENAL!!! I am picky with my BBQ, I'm from KC and there is a lot of great BBQ there. But this place is definitely up there. The slab of ribs were cooked perfectly and  the pulled pork was the best I've ever had! Ever!! It was moist and tender and delicious!! And the garlic toast baguette is great. The potato casserole was super good, but the beans were a little basic. Overall it made us go again.

2. So today was our second time trying it. The main disappointment is that we ordered delivery and they don't have the Picnic Barrel choices as menu options on Door Dash and we wanted to try the brisket and get the pulled pork again via the 2lb Picnic Barrel. So we had to order a la carte, which is why I think our portions were a little less than expected. The food was good though. Brisket wasn't as flavorful as I expected, and the pulled pork was less tender than the first visit. Also, our portion of pulled pork the first time was a lot more than this time, but with all that said, we were definitely happy with the food. We got the beans and just added some of the less tender pieces of meat to it and it was great that way. Also got the potato salad and that was really good! 

All in all, I'd DEFINITELY suggest this place, and we have done so!!! We will be ordering regularly!
great burger. love the scratch kitchen concept and the fact that they serve gluten free bread and entrees. We will definitely go back.

There are so many all you can eat sushi joints in Reno, but Asuka is definitely different and worth visiting! For the price of AYCE sushi, you can get the chinese buffet, hot pot, and sushi! Not only is there an amazing amount of options for the chinese food, its dang good! Our focus was more on the hot pot, mainly because of the conveyor belt of goodies passing right by our table. They had all the best options: rice noodles, udon noodles, glass noodles, fish cakes, shrimp, eggs, seaweed, crawdads, and a whole lot more. The servers will bring you all the beef, chicken and lamb you want as well. 
The sushi wasnt my favorite. The rolls weren't tightly rolled, and there was a limited selection, but for the price, why not just have a little of everything? 
My favorite part about this place was the staff. Everyone was so helpful. The drink station was at the end of the buffet line, suggesting that we were to fill our own refills, but we never had an empty cup, because the servers checked on us frequently. They even recommended how and what to cook for hot pot goodies. Overall the staff deserves 5 stars just for being so attentive and wonderful at their job. You'll see me again at Asuka!
Excellent! Just make sure to clean door handles often and have hand sanitizer available to the public.

I visited the restaurant 9-22 for a retirement party and noticed how beautiful the restaurant was inside. The floors, walls, decor was beautiful. The staff were also great, friendly people. I wasn't too excited about the food but because it was a party, options were limited. Overall great place to be!

Really yummy! Also HUGE portion for price - I got two servings out of the rice noodle soup I ordered. So great for the price! On that note, the 'soup' was not soupy at all. There was very little liquid. It was really good, tho. I hadn't had Tibetan food before - the flavor reminded me of Indian curry. It was a little more greasy/heavy than I could do on a regular basis but I would definitely eat again. Really nice guy that I ordered from on the phone, too. 

Pro tip: if you're getting take out, they don't call you when it's ready. So just walk inside and ask for it. I stood out in the cold for several minutes waiting for a call and not wanting to go in due to COVID restrictions. Finally, someone came out and asked me why I was loitering lol.

Honestly, this place is too expensive for what it is. 
The food isn't that great and the service is TERRIBLE. 
I went with a friend and the place was totally empty. They sat us down and we waited 15 minutes for them to even take our drink orders. I had to get up and ask them myself. 
As well as service, the food isn't worth the price. The pizza is usually burnt and the pasta over cooked.
Limited menu. Items are overpriced and look stale. No idea how they stay in business. Avoid this place at all costs.
Alicia was the best waitress that definitely knew her seafood and she gave us the best advice. If you are ever in town request her as the waitress. Food came out hot and fresh.

1. Chicken salad (ordered because it was recommended by the waiter) - not the best chicken salad I've had and it was filled to the brim with mostly mayo- and lacking flavor 
2. Buche De Noel Cake- it was good - but I wouldn't call it amazing 
3. Tiramisu- I'm a huge tiramisu fan and I didn't think it tasted anything like tiramisu- something was lacking 

Overall- the service is good but I don't think the food was all that it was hyped up to be

Had not planned on eating here, however thankfully our original place was too crowded so we ended up having lunch and thank goodness we did! Hidden gem indeed!! The rice and beans plus the choices of meat are incredible. Fall of the bone chicken and pork ribs, deliciously sweet plantains and a wonderful variety of sides makes this place unique. Will definitely return.
开车前往洛杉矶 路过圣巴巴拉 来到这家餐厅 真的很赞 海边美景 还有美食 真的很棒！不过要排队 推荐大家值得一试！
Delicious - every time. Wait staff is great. Order taker has a pleasant smile and a sense of humor.

Had goat saag . Was delectable and tender!!!!! Spices perfect so happy not to have to chew like a goat on the goat. I requested medium spice level and was not disappointed.  Fairly good size good for groups and families. They also honored a yelp coupon!

After confirming the pickup location multiple times, Grubhub still screwed up my pickup order and routed it to this location which is not near me rather than the location I thought I was ordering from.  I was on call and didn't have time to go to the restaurant so the proprietor delivered the food to me himself.  I really appreciated him going out of his way to correct a situation that wasn't his or his restaurant's fault.  (The only solution Grubhub offered me was to reorder and pay again a 2nd time for the order.)  The food was still warm and very delicious with the right balance of flavor and spice for me.  I won't be using Grubhub any longer, but I would definitely order from this place again.

Awesome place for a quick, casual burger. This is one of those places where I look at the menu, but get the same thing every time. All burgers are cooked and assembled right in front of you. The fries are great and I love to dip them in the Mooyah sauce. The Vets location looks sleek after their recent renovation. Plus, their rewards program is great.

I'm leaving this review for my benefit as a reminder. This restaurant has received great reviews, but for my family and me its a definite nope. I didn't realize until we ate food from here how great Golden House on the other side of town really is, real food and worth it.

Tried it again and surely won't be anything wrong this time! Wrong it was. Grits at 9am was like water and not even hot. How many times do I fool myself and go back!!!! The woman cleaning the table said are you suppose to be at this table??? I said yes the lady in front sent us over here. Then she said OK!!!! Friendly right? One more time like I am not smart but tried again since I live so close. We waited in lobby for awhile and saw many booths available. They told one man he couldn't get one but we sat down in one. No one came by or said anything for about 15 min. The manager came over and said a waitress would work her way to us soon. There were 3 waitresses and no one showed up so he brought us water but never asked what we wanted to eat or drink. Then I saw a waitress wait on a couple who came in abut 10 min after we sat down, We left!!!!!!!!!!  Isn't that crazy folks!!! For some reason they can't get this place together. 20 minutes and no waitress. Not good!

We stopped in without a reservation yesterday (a Saturday night during dinner rush), and we were accommodated with a table right away. I'm specifically leaving this review because our server Jana was a shining star! She was incredibly personable, attentive without being overbearing, and knew what we needed before we even asked. Between her and the brussels sprouts, we would definitely come back!

Our only complaint was the craft beer menu. It was incredibly difficult to read from where we were seated, and the lack of a printed copy made us reluctant to order a pint. Hard copies at the booths would make a huge difference.

This is by far my favorite mexican restaurant. I've been coming for 18 years and have always had an amazing experience. Friendly staff, amazing food, and cheap prices. They've never messed up an order of mine, and the atmosphere in the restaurant is so welcoming and friendly. My favorite thing to order is cheese enchiladas, rice, and queso. Their salsa and queso truly set them over the top.
edit: I feel the need to add that this is such fast service, it's amazing. There's never a moment of wondering "when's the food coming?"

This is my first time at this location, had a very bad experience.
Firstly we reserved in advance and was taken to table 25, the one at the last.
The table wasn't clean, straws and fork fallen below the table and the seats were not cleaned.
Bought to their notice , they did clean but found a lot of flies and something was biting my legs down the table.
Beware of the seats they give you!!
The best korean food that I have tasted so far in Louisiana! Highly recommended. I'm definitely coming back
Love this place. Prompt, hot and delicious pho. Never had Vietnamese before, I've been missing out. This place is great.
A tiny cup of coffee, soggy bacon and a pancake with the texture of rubber? No, thanks. I will not be coming here again.

We've been for breakfast before and it was just okay. Went to dinner here with friends last weekend. We all ordered some variety of chicken, which came out, at best, at room temperature. It was also over cooked and tough. Parmesan potatoes were not hot and way over cooked. Too hard to eat. Our server, while sweet, was horrible. Had to ask twice for our waters. Took forever to come take our order and even then, we had to tell her we were ready to order. Refills took forever.  We passed on dessert because it was just going to be too much trouble. Just not a good experience at all.

I been coming here since high school and im a junior in college. I consider yummy yummy to be a "hole in the wall". Most people dont come here because it is not mainstream as other bubble tea shops. However yummy yummy is great for that nostalgic sweet milk tea that tastes home made. The ladies who own the place are also super kind and are more friends that anything. They also have cheap meals especially for high school students who didnt make much. They are known for their waffles which are great. I recommend the milk tea and their flat pan fried noodles!
Mejor restaurante en todo RENO NV los mejores desayunos las mejores popusas y los mejores hotdogs ever
Great local bar! Wings were excellent (its a pizza & wings place!). Casual, great outdoor area as well!

It's a no for me! I haven't ate here in years and this is confirmation not to. Stopped in for lunch -- the hostess seemed to be over her job and the server did his best. 

I ordered the shrimp tacos with cilantro rice and cornmeal spoon bread. The food was very mediocre. Just bleh. It definitely taste like a place that's an American food chain restaurant. The chips and salsa was basic.


Nothing more to say. The menus were sticky and the food can be a lot better.

Good pizza, probably the closest I've found locally that tastes like NY pizza. The garlic knots are definitely the best around. Subs are good, and the pasta ain't bad either. It's got the feel of the old school northern pizza joint; artwork on the walls, video games, and a bit on the louder side. Literally, the only downer is sometimes the staff. Most are great, but there's always one or two that have to act like they're the stereotypical fake New York bozo. It doesn't fly up north, why would it here? Good for a laugh, though.

Absolutely delicious & happy to have them in the neighborhood!  Get the candy bacon - you won't regret it, and if you like biscuits, they have some of the best. I'm a big fan of "benedicts" so I love their different take. The pulled pork is delicious!  I love that you can fix and match 2 or 3 different kinds. This is what we usually do so we can all have a taste. Great for families as well as a group brunch.  I've gone several times, and each time, I try to join the waitlist through Yelp. Each time, I've arrived and checked in with the host at the stand to learn that my name was not on the waitlist. After 4 times of this happening, I stopped trying to join the waitlist. Just go, grab a signature mimosa from the bar, and enjoy the wait :) Cheers!
